title: Classic Margherita Pizza
description: Neapolitan-style pizza with tomato, fresh mozzarella, and basil. Minimal toppings, maximum flavor.
steps: Preheat the oven to 250°C (480°F) with a pizza stone or upside-down baking tray inside.
Stretch the dough into a 30 cm round on floured parchment.
Spread the passata thinly, leaving a 2 cm border.
Top with torn mozzarella and a pinch of salt.
Bake 10–12 minutes until the crust is blistered and the cheese bubbles.
Finish with basil leaves and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Chicken Adobo
description: Filipino braised chicken in soy sauce, vinegar, and garlic — savory, tangy, and better the next day.
steps: Combine chicken, soy sauce, and garlic in a bowl; marinate 30 minutes if you have time.
Sear the chicken skin-side down in a hot pot until browned.
Add the marinade, vinegar, water, bay leaves, peppercorns, and sugar. Do not stir yet.
Simmer uncovered 10 minutes, then cover and braise 30 minutes, turning once.
Uncover and reduce the sauce until glossy. Serve over rice.
notes: Adobo keeps for days and the flavor deepens — make a double batch.

title: Peanut Butter Overnight Oats
description: No-cook breakfast: assemble a jar the night before, grab it in the morning.
steps: Stir everything except the banana together in a jar.
Top with banana slices and an extra spoon of peanut butter before eating.
